_doc: Program 3 (Higher-Timeframe Directional Ontology) — TOY/behaviour family x CRYPTO-MAJORS on RESAMPLED H1/H4 data. Identical to research_config_majors.json except the universe is repointed at data/resampled with a {TF} template pattern (qualify_htf substitutes H1/H4 per --tf). A NEW horizon ontology, NOT a Program-1 parameter pass.
_horizon_doc: Program 3A = BAR_COUNT_CONSTANT (PRIMARY): harness warmup/window_size/max_forward stay in BARS, so each timeframe is its own world (ATR + bar-relative horizon scale naturally). Wall-clock implication: max_forward=40 bars = 10h at M15, 40h at H1, 160h at H4. Frozen + documented so a null is interpretable as 'this bar-relative ontology failed'. Program 3B (WALL_CLOCK_CONSTANT) is pre-defined but NOT implemented; only run if 3A's verdict warrants disambiguating horizon length from timeframe structure.
